mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather, featuring clear skies near Reddan Soccer Park and a full moon. Please be aware that the air quality index is currently at 51, and we expect an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain predicted.

Important updates for your commute include road construction on Highway M near the future Aldi site, which will require a detour from October 5 through October 7. Also, the city is reminding residents to be vigilant against scams involving fake payment requests for planning applications, noting that the city never accepts online credit card or wire transfer payments.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at various venues including Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's tomorrow. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on September 28 or trivia nights at the Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company on September 29.
In a noteworthy call from September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was detained and treated for injuries sustained during the incident.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the night. We look forward to them reopening tomorrow at 10:00 AM, when they will be serving the Oreo Reese's Cheesecake flavor of the day.
